---
title: "Test suggestions, step by step"
description: "Each step of the test suggestion workflow and the R functions behind it."
---

Part of [Under the hood](suggestions-internals.qmd): what the [test suggestions](test-suggest.qmd) do inside the R script, step by step.

The test workflow adds two things the roxygen workflow doesn't need: it
**runs tests** — before and after Claude's changes — and it deals with
**existing tests**, not only new ones.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  subgraph once ["Once per run"]
    cfg["① Load settings,<br/>describe the test data"]
  end
  subgraph prep ["For each function: ask"]
    direction LR
    read["② Read the function<br/>and its test files"] --> base["③ Run the existing<br/>tests, get the history"]
    base --> ask["④ Ask Claude"]
  end
  subgraph verify ["For each function: verify"]
    direction LR
    check["⑤ Check the<br/>answer"] --> cand["⑥ Write and run<br/>a candidate"]
    cand --> keep["⑦ Keep only<br/>what passed"]
    cand -. "new test failed" .-> classify["⑧ Ask Claude why"]
  end
  subgraph after ["After the last function"]
    fin["⑨ Set up testthat if needed,<br/>write the report"]
  end
  once --> prep --> verify --> after
```

## ① Load settings and describe the test data

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`resolve_shared_path()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/resolve_shared_path.R), [`read_json_config()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_json_config.R), [`read_text_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_text_file.R), [`read_package_name()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_package_name.R), [`check_datashield_type()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/check_datashield_type.R) | As for roxygen: settings, prompts, the package name and the `datashield-type` check. Claude settings come from the `test-review` profile in `config/claude.yml`. |
| [`check_dslite_setup_mode()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/check_dslite_setup_mode.R) | Stops the run on an unknown `dslite-setup` value. |
| [`code_issue_confidence_levels()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/code_issue_confidence_levels.R) | As for roxygen: which possible bugs in the code are reported, by Claude's confidence (`code-issue-confidence`; high and medium by default, `none` for no bug reporting). |
| [`package_function_names()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/package_function_names.R), [`detect_test_scheme()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/detect_test_scheme.R) | How your test files are named: `test-<R file>.R` (after the R file, e.g. `test-initMockData.R` for `R/initMockData.R`), or `test-<category>-<R file>.R` with categories such as `arg` or `smk` — recognised when at least half of the test files (and at least 3) follow it for R files or functions your package has. |
| [`test_support_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/test_support_files.R) | Lists your `tests/testthat/setup*.R` and `helper*.R` files — where logins, fixtures and helpers live. |
| [`summarize_test_data()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/summarize_test_data.R) | Describes the test data those files create, so Claude can check concrete values; never fails the run. |
| [`collect_test_data()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/collect_test_data.R) | Does the actual work in a separate R process: loads your package, runs the support files, and lists each table's rows, columns, types, missing values and factor level counts (also tables inside a DSLite server). |

With an open suggestion PR to build on (a PR or push run), first:

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`fetch_suggestion_pr_body()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fetch_suggestion_pr_body.R), [`decode_suggestion_state()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/decode_suggestion_state.R) | As for roxygen: the open suggestion PR's description and the findings of earlier runs kept hidden in it. |
| [`read_suggestion_choices()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_suggestion_choices.R), [`record_suggestion_choices()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/record_suggestion_choices.R) | Reads the checkboxes in that description (which suggestions you kept, declined or picked up) and records them, so the rebuilt description keeps them. |
| [`fetch_bot_branch()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fetch_bot_branch.R) | Fetches the suggestion branch. |
| [`materialize_bot_tests()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/materialize_bot_tests.R) | Puts the test files it changed in place, so its tests count as existing: they are run and shown to Claude, and not generated again. A test file you changed since the last review keeps your version. |

## ② Read the function and its test files

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`parse_r_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/parse_r_file.R) | Finds the function and its name, as for roxygen. |
| [`find_test_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/find_test_files.R), [`test_file_path()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/test_file_path.R), [`test_file_name()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/test_file_name.R), [`read_test_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/read_test_file.R) | Finds all test files of the function's R file: `test-<R file>.R` and, in a repository named by category, every `test-<category>-<R file>.R`. They are named after the R file, not the function, as in the other workflows. Names are matched exactly, so `ds.mean` doesn't pick up `ds.meanByClass`. |
| [`parse_test_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/parse_test_file.R) | Finds the `test_that()` blocks in each file, and marks which ones can be safely edited (unique name, own lines). |
| [`uses_ds_connections()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/uses_ds_connections.R) | DataSHIELD: whether the function works on DataSHIELD connections. Client functions always need them; utility functions only when this is true. |
| [`detect_connection_approaches()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/detect_connection_approaches.R) | DataSHIELD: how your tests already connect, anywhere under `tests/testthat/`: DSLite, DSOpal, DSMolgenisArmadillo, or a DSI login. |
| [`decide_dslite_setup()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/decide_dslite_setup.R) | DataSHIELD: following `dslite-setup`, whether to create a DSLite setup, follow how the existing tests connect, or — with `never` and no way to connect — leave the function untested and list it in the report. |
| [`build_test_role_guidance()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/build_test_role_guidance.R) | The testing strategy for the prompt: the default one; for DataSHIELD connections one that follows how your tests connect — or, for a new DSLite setup, the DSLite datasets Claude can choose from; for local utility functions temporary directories and mocked install or network calls. |

## ③ Run the existing tests and collect the history

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`run_test_blocks()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/run_test_blocks.R) | Runs a test file with your package loaded from source and reports each test as passed or failed, with the error. |
| [`format_test_results()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_results.R) | Turns those results into lines for the prompt, per test file. |
| [`build_test_evidence()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/build_test_evidence.R) | From git: when the function and each of its test files last changed, and in the changes under review (a PR or push, from the state before them) whether the function changed without its tests, with the diff. Helps Claude tell an outdated test from a bug. |

## ④ Ask Claude

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ask_claude_for_tests()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/ask_claude_for_tests.R) | Prepares and sends the request: function, test files, how they are named, support files, example tests, test data, test results and history. Returns Claude's fields. |
| [`format_test_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_files.R) | Puts the function's test files into the prompt word for word, each under its name. |
| [`format_earlier_test_findings()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_earlier_test_findings.R) | Lists the open earlier findings on the function — reported tests and generated tests that failed — each with an id, so Claude can judge them and doesn't repeat them. |
| [`format_test_scheme_guidance()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_scheme_guidance.R) | Where new tests go: `test-<R file>.R`, or the categories to choose from, with their meanings from `config/test-categories.json`. |
| [`test_sourced_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/test_sourced_files.R) | The files your support files `source()`, e.g. connection helpers in a subfolder. |
| [`format_test_support_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_support_files.R) | Puts your support files and the files they source into the prompt word for word, so the tests use your own objects, connection helpers and helpers. |
| [`example_test_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/example_test_files.R) | For a function without tests: one or two typical test files of other functions, as examples of how your package writes tests. |
| [`fn_source()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fn_source.R), [`fill_template()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fill_template.R) | As for roxygen: the function's code, and filling the prompt template. |
| [`build_submit_tests_tool()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/build_submit_tests_tool.R) | Defines the form: new tests (description, reason, setup code, assertions, and the category where test files are named by one — at most `max_new_tests`), decisions on existing tests with their file, setup and clean-up code for a new test file, the DSLite dataset if one is needed, which earlier finding a new test or report repeats and whether each still holds. The form is the same for every function of a run, so the prompt cache works; R checks the file names and ids Claude returns. |
| [`suggestion_reasons()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/suggestion_reasons.R) | The fixed list of reasons for new tests (`uncovered_branch`, `error_handling`, `edge_case`, `regression`, `other`). |
| [`call_claude_tool()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/call_claude_tool.R), [`split_cached_prompt()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/split_cached_prompt.R), [`log_claude_usage()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/log_claude_usage.R) | Sends the request to the Claude API, as for roxygen. The prompt is split before the function-specific part: instructions and your setup and helper files come first and are cached, so from the second function of a run they cost a tenth. Each call's token usage is logged. |
| [`refresh_anthropic_token()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/refresh_anthropic_token.R) | If the access token expired during a long run, gets a new one the same way the workflow got the first, and the call is repeated once. |
| [`warn_failed_call()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/warn_failed_call.R), [`note_retry_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/note_retry_file.R) | As for roxygen: if the call still fails, a warning on the run's summary page, and the file is noted, so that the next run tests it again. |

## ⑤ Check the answer

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`code_fingerprint()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/code_fingerprint.R), [`declined_suggestions()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/declined_suggestions.R) | Leaves out a new test, update or deletion you unticked earlier, as long as the function's code is unchanged; once the code changes, it may be suggested again. |
| [`accepted_reasons()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/accepted_reasons.R) | As for roxygen: which reasons a new test needs — the `accept-reasons` input, else `accept_reasons` in `config/claude.yml` (all but `other`). |
| [`place_new_tests()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/place_new_tests.R) | Filters Claude's new tests, leaves out the ones you declined, places each into its test file (by category where the repository uses them) and builds the code. |
| [`filter_generated_tests()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/filter_generated_tests.R) | Keeps a new test only if its reason is accepted, its name isn't taken, and its assertions aren't already in the file. |
| [`sort_test_decisions()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/sort_test_decisions.R) | Sorts Claude's decisions on existing tests by test file, leaves out the ones you declined, and passes each file's decisions through the safeguards below. |
| [`review_existing_tests()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/review_existing_tests.R) | Checks Claude's decisions on existing tests against the safeguards: the reason fits the action, only a failing test is updated, a possible bug is only reported — as a possible bug in the code if Claude is sure enough, else as a note. |
| [`assemble_test_block()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/assemble_test_block.R) | Builds the `test_that()` code from Claude's fields — the only place test code is assembled. |
| [`strip_artifact_lines()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/strip_artifact_lines.R) | Removes stray code fences Claude might have put into a field. |
| [`ensure_dslite_setup_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/ensure_dslite_setup_file.R) | DataSHIELD clients without a DSLite setup: writes `setup.R` (or `setup-dslite.R`) with the dataset Claude chose. |
| [`build_dslite_test_snippet()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/build_dslite_test_snippet.R) | The DSLite login code for that file. |

## ⑥ Write a candidate and run it, ⑦ keep what passed

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`apply_test_file_changes()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/apply_test_file_changes.R) | Does ⑥ and ⑦ for one test file at a time: writes a candidate with all changes, runs it, and rebuilds the file from the original with only what passed. |
| [`rewrite_test_content()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/rewrite_test_content.R) | Builds the test file from the original: updates in place, deletions removed, new tests added, every other line unchanged. |
| [`test_insert_line()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/test_insert_line.R) | Where new tests go: before a clean-up at the end of the file (a "shutdown" test or a disconnect), else at the end. |
| [`new_test_file_content()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/new_test_file_content.R) | A test file that doesn't exist yet: the new tests, framed by top-level setup and clean-up where your test files connect that way. |
| [`write_test_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/write_test_file.R) | Writes the file — or puts it back exactly as it was when nothing is kept. |
| [`run_test_blocks()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/run_test_blocks.R) | Runs the candidate file. |

## ⑧ Failed new tests

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`handle_failed_new_test()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/handle_failed_new_test.R) | Decides what becomes of a failed new test: a repeat of an earlier failure is skipped; otherwise it is classified, and becomes a possible bug in the code or a failed test (commented, or listed in a sweep's report). |
| [`ask_claude_to_classify_failure()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/ask_claude_to_classify_failure.R) | Shows Claude the failed test and its error output and asks why it failed: `real_bug`, `bad_test` or `env_misconfiguration`, and how sure it is. Uses its own profile, `test-failure-classification`. A test that failed in an earlier run (same name, or one Claude says it repeats) isn't classified, commented or filed again. |
| [`build_submit_failure_classification_tool()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/build_submit_failure_classification_tool.R) | The form for that answer: the reasoning first, then one of the three categories and a confidence. |
| [`create_bug_issue()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/create_bug_issue.R), [`post_issue_once()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/post_issue_once.R) | `real_bug` with a confidence to report: listed under possible bugs in the code, and at high confidence an issue, which outlives the PR — one per function: while it is open, further findings go there as comments. |
| [`post_test_failure_comment()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/post_test_failure_comment.R) | Every other failure, in a PR: a comment on your PR. |
| [`format_test_failure()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_failure.R) | The text of that comment — or, in a sweep, an entry in the report. |

## ⑨ Set up testthat and write the report

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`choice_line()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/choice_line.R), [`suggestion_choice()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/suggestion_choice.R) | Writes each suggestion that changes a file as a checkbox: ticked if applied, unticked if declined or not applied. Changing a box starts `suggestion-choices.yml`, which makes the bot branch match. |
| [`ensure_testthat_setup()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/ensure_testthat_setup.R) | If new tests were kept: creates `tests/testthat.R`, adds `testthat` to `Suggests`, and sets edition 3 for a fresh setup — so R CMD check runs the tests. |
| [`merge_test_findings()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/merge_test_findings.R) | After each function: merges its findings with the earlier ones — repeats skipped, a reported test that passes now resolved, earlier findings that no longer hold crossed out, never deleted. |
| [`restore_unproposed_files()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/restore_unproposed_files.R) | Puts back the suggestion branch's test files this run doesn't change, so only this run's files are proposed. |
| [`format_test_summary()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_summary.R) | The summary line of the open findings, e.g. "7 new tests · 1 existing test updated". |
| [`format_test_report()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/format_test_report.R) | The report, rebuilt from all findings on every run: new tests, changes to existing tests, possible bugs in the code (with a link to their issue), tests to look at, failed tests reported here rather than as comments, and functions left untested (`dslite-setup: never`) — grouped per file, each with the commit it came from, and what the latest review changed. |
| [`format_latest_review()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/format_latest_review.R), [`finish_suggestion_report()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/finish_suggestion_report.R) | As for roxygen: the "Latest review" line, and the end of the description (earlier reports, the hidden findings, the length limit). |
| [`finding_line()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/finding_line.R), [`group_title()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/group_title.R), [`encode_suggestion_state()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/encode_suggestion_state.R) | As for roxygen: one finding (crossed out with when and why if it no longer holds), a group's title, and the hidden findings for the next run. |
| [`publish_test_report()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/tests/publish_test_report.R) | Makes the report the suggestion PR's description; without one, a comment on your PR, or in a sweep one issue. |
